pairs.registryProposal: workspace-ancestry-isolation's 'Where this bites' lists evaluation workspaces, self-modifying loops and scratch clones; it omits the commonest case in a host app: one-shot utility LLM calls (titling, classification, extraction) spawned through a coding-harness CLI with no cwd, which inherit the host process's launch directory and so load an instruction floor written for unrelated work. Worth a bullet and a rule: utility spawns pin a span-empty cwd and restrict setting sources.
